issues.title: Form autoresponder email not sent to leads
issues.problem_statement: Leads were coming in from the customer's form, but the autoresponder email was not going to them.

items.description: Customer turned on the autoresponder option in the form settings and saved it, following support's guidance.
evidence: open form settings and turn on the autoresponder option then save it

items.description: Customer submitted a test lead from their page, following support's guidance, and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived in their inbox.
evidence: now submit a test lead from your page
done the mail came in my inbox

items.description: Support explained that the sender domain can be verified under email domain in settings, so that mails do not go to spam.
evidence: you can verify sender domain under email domain in settings, it is good so mails do not go to spam
